Primary (1 hour): Base Death Save +1 (returned if you avoid the Secondary). Reality warps and memory blurs: anyone who wins an opposed Persuasion Check against you can roll or pick your Personality and How You Feel About Most People from the Lifepath tables, and you act that way, sure it's always been you. Secondary (DV19): 1d6 Humanity Loss; addicted, −2 to Acting, Concentration, Conversation, Deduction, Human Perception and Persuasion for good.

Cost: 250eb (Expensive)

Item Compendium (2070) • Drugs
